sample_representation: all 2085 frozen evaluation genes in log1p(CP10K), without PCA compression
training_cells: all train and permitted vehicle controls in frozen split_v1
optimizer: scvi-tools 0.13 default Adam, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 1e-06, eps 0.01
delta: mean posterior latent of the drug's 10000 nM training cells minus mean posterior latent of all vehicle controls
prediction_source: 512 vehicle controls drawn without replacement per condition with numpy default_rng(10000 + seed)
prediction_decoder: deterministic decoder mean px, module in eval mode
prediction_postprocessing: clip negative predicted log-expression to zero; no renormalization or rounding
auxiliary_generation: each active step samples one of the 78 training conditions; 128 vehicle cells are encoded to posterior means, shifted by delta*log1p(dose)/log1p(10000) with delta from 128 of the drug's 10000 nM cells minus 128 other vehicle cells, decoded in eval mode with gradients, and clipped at zero
auxiliary_target: up to 128 measured cells of the sampled condition, held fixed (no gradient)
auxiliary_loss_scale: weight multiplied by update frequency so expected auxiliary coefficient equals the named weight
loss_scale_note: scVIDR base loss is about 106 per cell against about 0.22 for CellFlow flow matching, so the CellFlow weight grids are multiplied by about 486
fraction_loss_definition: Mean squared difference of real and generated soft fractions sigmoid((tau - r)/h) over training_taus, float64.
mmd_loss_definition: unbiased three-bandwidth RBF MMD squared in the frozen evaluation PCA space, float32
hyperparameter_selection: seed 0 validation only; repeat the selected WRF and MMD settings with seeds 1 and 2; the 13-threshold run reuses the selected 3-threshold WRF setting
